reduce redundant joins by materializing date filter

WITH valid_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS d_date_sk, d_date AS d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name, c.c_first_name AS c_first_name, vd.d_date AS d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM valid_dates)
        GROUP BY ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
    ) AS ss
    JOIN valid_dates AS vd ON ss.sold_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer AS c ON ss.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name, c.c_first_name AS c_first_name, vd.d_date AS d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk
        FROM catalog_sales
        WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM valid_dates)
        GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk
    ) AS cs
    JOIN valid_dates AS vd ON cs.sold_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer AS c ON cs.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name, c.c_first_name AS c_first_name, vd.d_date AS d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk
        FROM web_sales
        WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM valid_dates)
        GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk
    ) AS ws
    JOIN valid_dates AS vd ON ws.sold_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer AS c ON ws.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
